title: Capture: a work row when a session claims or finishes an item
goal: querylog.py capture turns a Bash or PowerShell PostToolUse whose command runs backlog.py claim, done or release ID into a work spool row {item, action} with the event's session_id, prompt_id and subagent id when present; a failed call (PostToolUseFailure) writes none; the row format is documented in kb/_self/querylog.md, Surfaces.

gates.question: The query log will record usage of every prompt inside a claim-to-done window, kb prompts or not (counts only, no text); prompts outside a window stay unrecorded. Approve this change to what the query log records?

notes: The PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure capture hooks already match Bash|PowerShell, so no hook changes: capture parses the command. tool_input.command holds the command (hooks.md:66, DOC S743). release is a claim given back; a window with no done or release ends at the session's end.
